description: Report a limit reading of the model account of this cable from the owner's machine (get_usage of Claude, rate limits of Codex, a 402 or 429 from the provider), with source and hour. used_pct 100, error_code 402 or monthly_cap mark the account exhausted: its cables go dark on all lines. 429 is a jam, not exhaustion.

error_code.description: 402 = the account is empty (its cables go dark on all lines), 429 = a jam (wait and retry, not exhausted), monthly_cap.

exhausted.description: The provider says the account is exhausted.

source.description: Where the reading comes from, e.g. get_usage, codex.rate_limits, provider_402.

used_pct.description: Used part of the window, 0..100 (100 = exhausted).

window.description: Limit window of the model account: 5h, day, week, month or balance.

name: cable_report_limits
